answer: To track a fictional order, sign in to the customer portal and open Orders > Tracking. If tracking is unavailable, contact the support team with your order reference.
To request an invoice, open Billing in the fictional customer portal and select the relevant order. For billing corrections, contact the support team.
Use the Forgot Password link on the fictional customer portal sign-in page. If you cannot regain access, contact account support.
For this fictional demo, customer support operates Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
